cohort: Women aged 20-45 years who have had at least one previous caesarean section, presenting at the Obstetrics and Gynecology department of Abbottabad Medical Complex, Abbottabad and Mufti Mehmood Teaching Hospital, D.I. Khan, Pakistan between December 2020 and May 2021.
finding: The frequency of placenta previa in women with previous caesarean sections was 17.7% (26 out of 147 patients).
